description: Find claimed physicians, dentists, attorneys or accountants listed on Siporpro. Use free text (e.g. "cardiologist Panama City", "abogado de migración") and/or filters. Words that name a place must match the professional's location; results match every word when possible (match: all), else some of them (match: partial). Returns ranked matches with their public page URL and can_book (true = request_booking works for them). Only real, claimed profiles are listed.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. PA, US, MX.

lang.description: Language for the answer (ISO 639-1): es, en, pt, fr, de, it, zh, ja, ko, ar, hi, ru, id. Default en.

language.description: Only professionals who attend in this language (ISO 639-1, e.g. es, en).

profession.description: physician (medical doctor), dentist, attorney (lawyer) or accountant (CPA).

query.description: Free text: specialty, name, area, need. Any language.

name: search_professionals

match.description: all = every query word matched; partial = only some did (none matched all).

title: Search professionals
